description: Send a push notification drawing on your credit token instead of an API key. Use this when you have no AgentSignal account. Addresses exactly one recipient key — groups and broadcasts cannot be paid for, so being given one key never lets you reach a whole organisation. Call open_credit first if you have no token.

body.description: What the person will read on their lock screen. Say what happened and what it means for them; they may have no other context.

priority.description: normal is the default. high is delivered at once and marked time-sensitive, so use it only when interrupting is warranted -- it does not get past Do Not Disturb. Emergency alerts that repeat until acknowledged need an account.

title.description: Bold first line. Defaults to the channel name.

to.description: The recipient key you were given, e.g. "u_8fk2…".

url.description: A link shown under the message.

name: notify_paid
title: Notify someone using credit rather than an account
